message.content:
**Historically (all‑time)**  
The Los Angeles Lakers’ all‑time leading scorer is **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar**, who amassed **2,643 points** for the franchise during his 14‑season tenure (1975‑1989).

**Currently (as of the 2025‑26 season)**  
The Lakers’ leading scorer on the roster is **LeBron James**, averaging about **27.5 points per game** in the 2025‑26 season.
